title: Unbounded compact-support normalization on a closed affine chart
statement:
Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, let $\ell\ne p$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, choose a uniformizer $t$ of its valuation ring, and put $A=\mathcal O_E/t^n$ with $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $f:X\to Y$ a $k$-morphism, and $u:U\hookrightarrow X$, $v:V\hookrightarrow Y$ affine open immersions. Let $r\ge0$, $P=\mathbf A^r_V$ with projection $\pi$, and $i:U\hookrightarrow P$ a closed immersion satisfying $fu=v\pi i$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-affine-space]. Put $W=P\setminus i(U)$ and $j:W\hookrightarrow P$. Then $A$ is finite, $\ell^n A=0$, and $\ell^n$ is invertible on these schemes. The schemes $X,Y,U,V,P,W$ are Noetherian (admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]) and finite type over $k$; the open immersions $u,v,j$ are quasi-compact. The displayed maps and their composites are separated finite-type and admit compactifications. Use ordinary unbounded small-etale constant-$A$ module derived categories and compact support [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Exact open extension gives $u_!\dashv u^*$ and $v_!\dashv v^*$ with the extension-by-zero evaluation counits. If $F=Rf_{!,A}$ and $H=R\pi_{!,A}$, there is a canonical refinement-independent natural isomorphism on the entire derived categories
$$\lambda:Fu_!\xrightarrow{\sim}v_!Hi_*.$$
Here $i_*$ is exact termwise closed direct image [lem-exc-closed-support-triangle]. Specify $\lambda$ as the composite $Fu_!\cong R(fu)_!=R(v\pi i)_!\cong Rv_!R\pi_!Ri_!\cong v_!Hi_*$, using the unbounded composition comparisons [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons], the identity-proper compactifications for open factors with the source-open normalization [lem-amb-compact-support-open-source-composition], and the canonical quasi-finite support comparison for the closed factor [lem-sfb-quasifinite-compact-support-exact]. These normalizations use the ordinary open adjunctions and the exact closed direct image, with no bounded-below restriction.

proof.text: Use Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing for finiteness. Extract the integer-ring maximal-ideal characterization and uniformizer generation from extension_integers_dvr. The spectral absolute value of ell is its p-adic norm, which is less than one; hence ell lies in the uniformizer ideal. Ideal.pow_mem_pow puts ell^n in its nth power, so its image in the coefficient quotient is zero. Characteristic p and primality of ell show ell is nonzero in k: p dividing ell would force p=1 or p=ell. Map the unit ell^n in k to global sections along each displayed structure morphism.

source.place: Locality and Charts supplement: finite coefficient hypotheses

proof.text: Apply Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace to obtain Noetherian X and Y. The open maps u and v give locally Noetherian U and V, and affineness makes them compact. Mathlib already makes the finite-dimensional affine-space projection locally of finite presentation; its affine source gives compactness. Thus P is Noetherian. The open embedding j induces a Noetherian topology on W, and its locally finite type map to P gives local Noetherianness. Consequently W is Noetherian and every arrow with one of these sources is quasi-compact. These arguments include r=0 and empty schemes.

Use comp_over for f and cancel the structure morphism to obtain separatedness and local finite type of f. The remaining displayed maps are open or closed immersions, affine-source maps, or composites, so the usual Mathlib instances supply separatedness and local finite type. Every source is Noetherian, hence every arrow is quasi-compact. Every target is compact and quasi-separated. The Nagata HasCompactification instance then provides compactifications for all eighteen arrows. Discharge the two finite lists by their membership cases.

proof.text: A closed immersion is finite, so WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Finite.Exact provides exact direct image directly. Choose the already-defined derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction for both open adjunctions. The specified equalities are reflexive. Form e from exactly the seven isomorphism factors in EtaleChartCompactSupportNormalization, including the canonical proper comparison and exact-derived closed direct image. No new adjunction descent or quasi-finite-support existence package is required.

For compactifications cf,cp define mu by transporting e with rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A cf on the source side and its inverse for cp on the target side, exactly as required. Apply unboundedEtaleCompactSupport_comparison_coherence to f and the affine-space projection. Its cocycle with the chosen compactification identifies the left transport; invert and cancel the projection cocycle for the right transport. Apply Iso.ext and NatTrans.ext; functoriality and associativity reduce the refinement square to those two cocycle identities.
